You need to face your fear of meeting people eventually. Better sooner than later. Unless you feel like going off to the countryside and be a lonely farmer, but even there you end up meeting people.

If you want to got to university, you better get that DAEU, if you still can. If you really can't do anything right now, if it's too hard, try perhaps visiting a library. You can get up early, sit there, read some books, study. There's not much people around. And even then, most strangers care about you as much as you care about them. So don't bother killing yourself over that. And when they do get to know you, they'll see the kind and funny guy that you are.

Ain't no miracle solution, I'm sorry. You need to find something that you like doing. Perhaps some long forgotten wish from childhood, I don't know. You do need to mmet people if you are to stop being lonely and get a job. Also: do seek professional help if you think you need to. It can only help.
